podcast.title: Matriarch and Performer
podcast.body: Rita Marley is the mother of several of Bob Marley's musical children and performed with the Melody Makers, including on their hit song "Tomorrow People." "It features Ziggy, Mother Rita, Sisters Sadella, and Sharon and Brother Stephen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Singer, Producer, and Grammy Winner
xref.body: Steven Marley, the second son of Bob and Rita Marley, is a singer and producer. He has won eight Grammy Awards for his work. "Steven is the second son of Bob and Rita Marley. He's also a singer and producer with eight Grammy Awards."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
